name: feature-marker
author: Vinicius Carvalho
description: Automate complete feature development lifecycle: PRD → Tech Spec → Tasks → Implementation → Tests → PR. AI-powered skill for Claude Code with TUI and macOS menubar apps. Structured outputs: JSON specs, task templates, test cases, PR descriptions. Integrates with Linear, GitHub, Notion.
longDescription:
Feature Marker is a comprehensive feature development workflow automation tool that guides teams through the complete lifecycle of feature development:

**Workflow Phases:**
1. PRD (Product Requirements Document) — Define what to build
2. Tech Spec — Technical architecture and design
3. Tasks — Break down into actionable work items
4. Implementation — Write the code
5. Tests — Unit and integration testing
6. PR — Create pull requests with generated descriptions

**Key Features:**
- AI-powered guidance at each phase
- Project-aware: learns from existing specs and patterns
- Structured JSON outputs for automation
- Task generation with estimates
- Test case generation
- Auto-generated PR descriptions
- Linear integration for issue creation
- GitHub integration for PR management
- Notion database support
- TUI (Terminal UI) for interactive workflows
- macOS menubar app for quick access

**Use Cases:**
- Product teams: Standardized feature documentation
- Engineering: Reduce overhead in feature planning
- Collaboration: Single source of truth for feature specs
- Quality: Built-in test planning and coverage
- Velocity: 60%+ faster feature cycles

installation.homebrew: brew tap viniciuscarvalho/tap && brew install feature-marker
